what: SLB, formerly Schlumberger, is the largest oilfield services company. It provides the technology and crews that find, drill and produce oil and gas: seismic imaging, drilling systems, well completion and production chemistry.
customers: National oil companies and international energy producers, with a large share of revenue outside North America.
money: production equipment, software and data services
moat: Technology and an engineering workforce in nearly every producing country, which national oil companies rely on for complex offshore and deepwater work.
risks: Spending by oil producers is cyclical and fell in North America
Revenue declined about 2% in the last financial year
Middle East and offshore projects are concentrated among few customers
Long-term oil demand faces pressure from the energy transition
opportunities: International and offshore work, where it is strongest, holds up better than US shale
Its digital and software business carries far higher margins than field services
The ChampionX acquisition adds production chemicals, a steadier revenue stream
watch: International revenue growth and the digital segment's share of profit.
